messages:
alex: Heads-up — seeing quota/billing hits attributed to org-admin after the role-revoke funnel rolled out sampling. Anyone else?

maria: Saw spikes. Revoke API sometimes lands via auth-proxy which strips project claim. Sampling surfaced the noisy path.

jamal: We only changed sampling window/trace ids last week — surprised this surfaced.

alex: The telemetry join expects origin_project in the identity header. If proxy swaps headers pre-sampling, we lose the claim.

sara: Repro: console -> Roles -> Revoke -> confirm. Intermittent path goes through proxy when the console uses the short-lived exchange.

maria: Quick mitigation: have telemetry backfill origin_project from prior auth event in trace before sampling applied.

jamal: That fixes reporting but billing needs deterministic routing. Propose API fallback: prefer explicit project claim in token exchange; else consult authn-cache for last effective identity.

alex: Proposed rollout: (1) authn-cache lookup fallback in API (canary), (2) metrics: auth_attribution_fallback_count and an alert if > threshold, (3) console patch to send X-Origin-Project on revoke path, (4) backfill job to reclassify last 48h telemetry.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-proxy patch -> canary deploy in 20m.

maria: I'll mock a Console Billing card: "Attribution source: token | fallback | proxy" for ops visibility and add to rollout doc.

jamal: UX ask: add audit tooltip on revoke showing billing-identity: "You are revoking as: service-account X (project Y) — charges will apply to project Y." Low friction and reduces tickets.

sara: Also add a short-lived /metrics counter and a Grafana panel.

alex: Filing incident: INC-2026-revoke-attr. Impact: misattributed billing. Linking canary and runbook. Monitoring now. :thumbsup:
